item: Netherlands (NL) jurisdiction not reviewed; repo flagged only Japan (F09)
detail: The project owner is located in the Netherlands. Whether skill-based leaderboards, referral features or rewards fall inside or outside that test is a legal question that this repository does not answer. The Kansspelautoriteit Kansspelwijzer lists licensed providers. Notes: research/nl-legal-review.md. Not a legal conclusion.
action_requested: Keep wagering, referral and reward features disabled until Dutch-law review. Check the Kansspelwijzer status of any sportsbook or price source before use.
